character: Sir Bonk: a huge good-hearted self-appointed knight, bucket helm and broom crest, cream tabard, pot-lid pauldrons, bedsheet cape, wooden plank greatsword. 68 joints, Humanoid body with Mixamo names and full fingers; cape chains Cape_L/C/R1..4 stay at rest because the game drives them. Weapon0 is the 2.26 m plank on his right hand, with bladeHilt/bladeEnd anchors around its 1.42 m blade.
description:
Airborne The BONK: the heavy aerial partner of ground.3. Both hands haul the plank high and back over the right shoulder, a readable loaded back arch, then the hips lead a deep forward fold and the plank chops down through the space ahead to below his boots. Legs trail behind as counterweight. He keeps falling normally: no hover, forced dive, root travel, ground stamp, planted foot, somersault or second slash. Clean knight effort, no gag. The grounded reference gives attitude and overhead body mechanics only; do not copy its floor impact, planted lunge or old clock.

The weapon arc is the move. The plank itself is the hitbox from28 through37. At28 it is already sweeping forward/down in front, not still winding up behind him. By33 its tip is below both boots and clear of his legs. Continue that downward/front arc through37; no long parked hold at the low pose. This is distinct from Sunrise's rising overhead rainbow and Barn Door's horizontal sweep. Use torso and hips, not an arm-only chop. There is no floor to stop the plank.

Entry is actual fall reference tick0, not grounded idle. Fixed actor root, ordinary movement/gravity. Hips may move a little locally, but never plunge the whole model to satisfy tip depth. Cape_L/C/R1..4 stay at rest for runtime springs. The real current model also has a pot lid on the left arm; keep a clear outline and avoid bucket, crest, pauldrons, torso, cape and knees.

Fixed story poses at60Hz:
-0: exact fall tick0, plank back over right shoulder, free left arm balancing.
-6: left hand joins a loose second grip below the right, plank upright outside right shoulder and raised knee. Hands/handle clear the body.
-14: overhead load. Both hands high and outside the bucket's right side, plank pointing back/down behind him; back arches with chest opening, hips less. Knees tuck asymmetrically, visibly airborne.
-24: maximum load, same overhead-back intent with greater tension and contrast. Blade tip behind hips and below hilt, both hands high. Face slit stays visible, elbows follow hands rather than winging sideways. This is a loaded key, not a full grounded squat.
-28: first downward contact ahead. Hips have driven forward, chest folds after, hands lead forward and down; plank slopes forward/down, tip clearly ahead and below hilt. Legs begin trailing back against the stroke. Do not already finish the chop before28.
-33: deep cut below boots. Chest folds forward, arms reach down and forward with bent but open elbows. Blade points down/front, tip below BOTH feet, hilt in front away from belly. Legs trail behind and separate enough to clear the plank. No actor-root descent or invented foot plant.
-37: end of chop, still forward/down and below boots, carrying farther along the arc from33. Keep it clear of knees and shins. Body finishes the forward fold; no second cut.
-45: heavy heave back toward the outside right shoulder; both hands may help. Lift around the outside, not through face or chest; begin unwinding the body and restoring legs. Left hand releases after this key.
-58: exact fall tick0 for late auto-cancel.
-66: exact same fall, free to act.

Hands: owner accepted loose approximate two-hand hold (left8-16cm below right), not mirrored exact fists. Use two_hand_grip(hold='loose',hilt_weight=2.0,spine=False), elbows='hands' with hands near/above head, elbows=True low/front where appropriate. Seed neighbouring keys. Keep manual torso drive: leaving spine free previously folded the fighter into a0.5m plunge and wrong chest turn. Measure achieved hilt; default0.3weight retracted hands into torso on Barn Door. The accepted Sunrise repair raised/outset overhead hands and forearms to clear bucket. Use that lesson without copying its rising arc. Do not float the left hand to hide contacts. Wrists and hinges remain plausible; report compromises.

ONE OWNER-AUTHORIZED MOTION REVISION. The first take preserved every key but failed LH snap/roll checks and used a lower pendulum path instead of an overhead chop. Owner agreed this needs adjustment. Re-author arm/hand/weapon poses at load24 and contact28, with a coherent grip/twist that allows the tip to travel behind/up/OVER the head into forward-down contact at28. These two arm/weapon poses are UNLOCKED; do not keep forcing the failed endpoint twist states. Other approved key anchors0,6,14,33,37,45,58,66 remain within2cm of original keys. At24/28 preserve accepted hips/spine/head/leg poses as much as possible; the permission is for arms/hands/weapon, not a whole-body redesign. Report any needed supporting torso variation rather than silently moving it.

Keep66ticks, contact28, active28-37, belowbootscut33/37, fall58/free66. Preserve root, cape atrest, ordinary falling and repaired trailingleg silhouette. Keep useful37-45 outside-right heave and clean45-58 release; blend only locally where revised entry requires. No secondslash, pendulum substitute, hidden handflip, hover, forceddive or retiming. A clear motion path and anatomically continuous grip take precedence over the old24/28 arm arrangement. Accepted key contacts may improve but do not spend the take on unrelated global polishing.

Start from previous/result.json and previous/motion.py, with keys/result.json providing retained anchors. The previous nine failed overhead variants used locked endpoints; they do not prove an overhead path is impossible once24/28 arms can change. Use sequential seeded solves and deliberate breakdowns, manage left palm/forearm twist, keep spine=False in twohand solves and hilt_weight2.0 as appropriate. No uniform elbowsdown overhead. Save changed loadable checkpoint within5min and reconstructable revision.py or motion.py. Run FULL default motioncheck and inspect full paths plus actual affected hand/breakdown images from profile/front/rearquarter/gameplay. One revised take for owner review, no integration.

Before delivery inspect the provisional weapon arc with genra.hitarc using scratch defender-hurtboxes.json, radius0.5, active28-37, calibration bonk. Report total/ahead/behind coverage for FightGuy and Manki and whether below-feet coverage reads. Grounded calibration is approximate, not cooked guarantee. Do not invent coverage minima or alter hitbox geometry to chase a score. No Unity, package, toolkit, binding or cooked edits.
